family_resolution.match: first top-level slug component after parent-chain verification

required_context: resolved receptor identity and receptor chain
dual structure numbering and GPCRdb residue mapping
construct, partner, fusion, mutation, glycan, cleavage, and assembly context

hard_gates.when: candidate is on the G-protein, arrestin, or intracellular transducer face
hard_gates.exception: intracellular delivery is explicitly authorized and reassessed

hard_gates.when: candidate side chains face the bilayer or require framework insertion into membrane
candidate belongs only to a fusion, tag, artificial linker, stabilizer, or unexplained engineered feature
receptor chain or candidate residue mapping is ambiguous
extracellular side, membrane orientation, or approach path cannot be established
candidate requires passage through membrane, intact native domain, or a pore too narrow for the proposed binder
candidate depends on a crystal contact or unverified oligomer
hard_gates.exception: biological assembly and functional evidence support the interface

001.name: Class A (Rhodopsin)
architecture_checks: small-molecule, lipid, peptide, protein, light, or tethered-ligand input
orthosteric pocket depth and extracellular vestibule width
inhibit_hypotheses: protease-cleavage or tethered-ligand blockade when applicable
activate_hypotheses: reachable active-state pocket core or trigger network
mandatory_risks: deep pocket may accept a small molecule but not a protein binder
TM residue may be lipid-facing rather than pocket-facing
crystal dimer may not be functional
stop_if: small-molecule and peptide recognition modes remain conflated
candidate pocket access cannot accommodate the proposed scaffold

002.name: Class B1 (Secretin)
architecture_checks: intact structured ECD and ECD-to-TMD orientation
peptide C-terminal ECD capture and N-terminal TMD trigger
ECD disulfides, glycans, linker flexibility, and construct truncation
mandatory_risks: stand-alone ECD pose may lack membrane reference
full peptide contact shell is too broad for conditioning hotspots
glycan or ECD orientation may block approach
stop_if: ECD and TMD recognition roles cannot be separated
native ECD is absent but the hypothesis depends on it

003.name: Class B2 (Adhesion)
architecture_checks: full modular ECD and GAIN domain composition
mandatory_risks: TMD-only construct may omit the causal ECD mechanism
cleavage and fragment association may differ from native receptor
large ECD may occupy the proposed binder path
stop_if: cleavage or tethered-agonist status is unresolved
hypothesis depends on an ECD absent from the structure

004.name: Class C (Glutamate)
architecture_checks: VFT, cysteine-rich domain, and TMD composition
homodimer or heterodimer identity and stoichiometry
orthosteric ECD versus allosteric TMD ligand
mandatory_risks: isolated protomer approach may clash with partner
heterodimer partner roles are not interchangeable
ECD and TMD sites have different mechanism logic
stop_if: functional protomer identity or stoichiometry is unresolved
partner protomer is omitted from approach analysis

005.name: Class D1 (Ste2-like fungal pheromone)
mandatory_risks: Class A motifs and pocket rules may not transfer
experimental structure coverage may be sparse
stop_if: candidate relies only on an unvalidated Class A analogy

006.name: Class F (Frizzled)
architecture_checks: Wnt, protein, lipid, or sterol context
mandatory_risks: sterol or lipid site may be intramembrane and inaccessible
detached CRD pose may lack membrane reference
Frizzled and Smoothened mechanisms are not interchangeable
stop_if: family sub-branch or native ECD orientation is unresolved

007.name: Class O1
architecture_checks: receptor-specific domains, ligand, state, and topology
activate_hypotheses: receptor-specific accessible state or trigger site
mandatory_risks: transferable family priors may be sparse
stop_if: hypothesis depends only on analogy to another GPCR class

008.name: Class O2
architecture_checks: receptor-specific domains, ligand, state, and topology
activate_hypotheses: receptor-specific accessible state or trigger site
mandatory_risks: generic numbering and structural coverage may be incomplete
stop_if: access geometry or assay-linked mechanism is unavailable

009.name: Class T2
architecture_checks: exact receptor, species, and ligand modality
receptor-specific extracellular vestibule and TMD evidence
mandatory_risks: structural and pharmacological coverage may be sparse
deep-pocket claims may exceed available evidence
stop_if: membrane-facing status or ligand-site mapping is unresolved

010.name: Other GPCRs
architecture_checks: receptor-specific ligand, state, dimer, and autoinhibition evidence
activate_hypotheses: receptor-specific accessible state or trigger site
mandatory_risks: Other is a routing category, not a mechanism
stop_if: analysis requires forcing the receptor into an unsupported class template

dimer_or_oligomer.applies_when: functional oligomer evidence exists or the hypothesis depends on an interface
required_checks: both protomers in membrane-referenced approach model

large_ecd_or_autoinhibition.applies_when: VFT, CRD, GAIN, large ECD, or endogenous blocking segment is present
required_checks: native domain occupancy of binder approach path
large_ecd_or_autoinhibition.inhibit_prior: stabilize closed/autoinhibited state or block trigger exposure
large_ecd_or_autoinhibition.activate_prior: release block, mimic trigger, or stabilize productive coupling

tethered_agonist.applies_when: proteolysis or displacement exposes an endogenous agonist segment
required_checks: intact, cleaved, and trigger-mutant assay controls
